story.title: Any Means Necessary
story.blurb: In a dark warehouse, three armored Ravens, Odran, Sascha and their leader, take stock of a fallen comrade and vow to wipe out whoever is responsible.

lines.text: The figures stood still in the darkened room, the only light emanating from the dual holograms. It was dead silent, with not another living soul nearby. The ghostly emptiness of the warehouse was enough to make one queasy, just from being there. One of them swiped away on their wrist device, staring sharply at the screens.
“Vitals are unresponsive, boss,” said the figure in blue.

lines.text: The three closed the helmets on each of their mechanical suits, the armors’ eyes radiating menacingly as they marched. The Ravens had worked long and hard, performing countless acts of terrorism, always inching closer to their goal. If the Galactic Union wanted to wrestle, they’d wrestle. If the Horizoners wanted to brawl, they’d sure as hell brawl.
They would restore their former glory.
Through any means necessary.
